title: Negative: a self-secreted repellent trail does not let digestion-dependent predators cross between prey; weak trails leave them on prey, stronger ones scatter them, and in every run all free predators dissolve with 0 hops and reproduction collapses
summary: wswim.py = wconv.py of 20261027T1012-c56-free-predator-designs (intrinsically condensing predator material that decays to a soluble form and is rebuilt only by its digestion product; B4 parameters: Mb 0.02, kx 5e-4, kr 0.03) plus TOOLBOX kstrail propulsion: predator material secretes a slow repellent h (dh = Dh lap h + bh c_b - kh h) and drifts down it (MUSCL volume-filling flux, chih). Labkit 128^2, t=12000. chih*bh 0.05-0.5 (h1, h3, h10, h3k): the repellent disperses predator material out of its bodies and the fuel taxis collects it inside prey, which stop dividing (0 prey and 0-1 predator persistent splits). chih*bh 0.005 (w5): 29% of predator bodies free, 100 of 104 free-ending tracks dissolve, 1 persistent predator split; 0.01 (w10, seeds 0 and 1): 69-70% free, 156/159 and 126/131 dissolve, 0 persistent predator splits; 0.02 (w20): 51% free, 0 splits. Hops (contact, free spell, contact > 10 px away in one track) 0 in every run. The trail does not give a free predator enough directed travel before its body decays (median free spell 800 t).

finding.operator: self-repellent trail propulsion (kstrail) on digestion-dependent condensate predators
finding.control: same world without the trail (20261027T1012-c56-free-predator-designs conv_B4: 28% free, 17 persistent predator splits, generation 3)
finding.result: trail strength chih*bh 0.005/0.01/0.02/>=0.05: free share 0.29/0.69/0.51/0; predator persistent splits 1/0/0/0-1; hops 0 in all 7 runs

limits: One seed per setting except w10 (two); the repellent's Dh and kh were varied only in drive-level screens (s8: Dh 0.1 and kh 0.003 also dissolved the predators). I did not measure swimming speed directly; labkit counts 10-74 moving predator tracks. The kstrail recipe needs a fast attractant for cohesion and a body radius >= 6 px; here cohesion comes from the predator's own double well and the bodies are 3-5 px, which may be why the trail disperses rather than propels.
